title: Photograph of Laurent's band with Picou
summary: Laurent names the musicians in the band picture, including Picou, a trumpeter, Billy Pierce at piano, Fan Bourgeois, a trombonist and Albert Francis on drums.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
